intro: Deathstalker Lesh is a Forsaken rogue serving as a forward scout at Southpoint Tower in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Operating directly under High Executor Darthalia, she keeps watch over the human farms in the Hillsbrad Fields to gauge when the Forsaken should strike.

p: Perched at Southpoint Tower on the southern road through the Hillsbrad Foothills, Deathstalker Lesh monitors the human farmers and town militia working the nearby Hillsbrad Fields. As an operative of the Deathstalkers—the Forsaken's secretive intelligence and assassination network—Lesh tracks enemy movements and numbers for High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill. When the human defenses show weakness, Lesh coordinates targeted raids to keep the Alliance population destabilized and pave the way for Forsaken expansion southward.
